data.body:
Close evidence, each acceptance box mapped (checked on main at d5f10d1d2c8, 2026-11-20 PST). All 6 children closed: calcite-cursed-lovebird, unequaled-sincere-firefly, notorious-deadsmooth-rattail, prosaic-visionary-basilisk, waterish-aquamarine-bug, childproof-adrenal-macaw.
AC1 (ADR superseding ADR 0049 pinning merged): docs/adr/0125-opcert-trust-per-environment.md on main, landed 13210300d78 (calcite-cursed-lovebird).
AC2 (pin file and trusted-env gone, no code reads a pin file): .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml absent; git ls-files has no trusted_env path; 'rebar trusted-env' returns 'unknown subcommand'; the only src mentions are the removal note in _cli/_parsers/advanced/certs.py (removed in f2c25a5f863, prosaic-visionary-basilisk). Remaining pinned-key prose in src was removed by childproof-adrenal-macaw (fed3d35d08f).
AC3 (no list: any valid key passes, tampered/wrongly bound fails, key and environment reported): tests/unit/test_opcert_trust_list.py test_no_list_certifies_any_valid_key_and_names_key_and_environment and test_no_list_still_refuses_tampered_and_replayed_certs; landed 07fb310edd4 (notorious-deadsmooth-rattail). test_opcert_trust_list.py + test_opcert_cross_environment_c21f.py + test_attest_opcert.py: 45 passed on main today.
AC4 (with a list: unlisted untrusted, listed passes): test_unlisted_key_is_untrusted, test_listed_key_under_another_environment_is_untrusted, test_listed_key_for_its_environment_passes_with_trust_list_basis; landed 0e5b0581749 (unequaled-sincere-firefly).
AC5 (MCP server lists the 3 keys, /health op-cert passes after deploy): recorded in this epic's 2026-11-20 comment from a read-only SSM check at 13:58 PST (3-entry REBAR_VERIFY_TRUSTED_OPCERT_KEYS; /health opcert bound, expected, matched true, trust_source trust_list, no error). Not re-checked after the later deploys of fed3d35d08f and d5f10d1d2c8, which do not touch the deployment's trust setting.
AC6 (make verify green, landed through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1): children's changes per the 2026-11-20 comment; childproof-adrenal-macaw Gerrit 3493 at LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, local make verify 21563 + 226 passed.
Boxes were already ticked; wording unchanged.
